atoms.b: Labrador Retrievers are a dog breed. Their coats can be black, chocolate or yellow. Labs are often used for hunting, but also make wonderful pets! They are friendly, loyal and smart.

atoms.b: Dalmatians are a dog breed. They have black spots on their coats, but they are born completely white as puppies. Fire stations in America use Dalmatians as mascots. They also make good pets!
